issue.body:
This is still a WIP.

I create the PR now because there are several issues to discuss:
- The [`no-reserved-keys`](http://eslint.org/docs/rules/no-reserved-keys) rule has been removed. It is kind of replaced by [`quote-props`](http://eslint.org/docs/rules/quote-props) but to enable this rule, we need to choose how we want deal with quotes on object properties. The `consistent` option seems to be the most conservative one if the goal is to limit changes in our code.
- The [`indent`](http://eslint.org/docs/rules/indent) rule changed quite a lot and has now options to control the indentation of specific cases:
  - `SwitchCase`: I set it to 1, meaning that the `case` statements need 1 level of indent (== 2 spaces) compared to the `switch`. There are a few places where we don't follow this rule, like [here](https://github.com/nodejs/io.js/blob/d5ab92bcc1f0ddf7ea87a8322824a688dfd43bf5/test/pummel/test-fs-watch-file-slow.js#L21-L35).
  - `VariableDeclarator`: I set it to 2. This allows us to align multiple variable declarations with `var` or `let` like:

``` js
var x = 0,
    y = 1,
    z = 2;
```

I haven't pushed the lib and test changes yet because I think there are some problems in eslint with the indent rule. I'll reference this PR when I file the issues.
